results.title: A 429 from the quota path
results.evidence: 4 refusal code(s) map to 429 — ['budget_exhausted', 'cost_limit_reached', 'quota_limit_reached', 'rate_limit_reached'] — and no route or service anywhere sets a `Retry-After` header. The status says *come back later*; the header is the only part of that a client can act on, and every one of these limits is a window MAYA knows the length of.
